ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics platform for MiWay bus transit routes using Poisson regression and spatial modeling to forecast passenger surges and optimize scheduling.
ideas.title: Mississauga Local Transit Demand Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the data-driven forecasting approach of winning projects like ai-incident-forecasting, appealing to judges looking for rigorous statistical modeling over basic UI wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-scoring dashboard for local financial compliance, utilizing LightGBM and graph intelligence to flag suspicious commercial transactions.
ideas.title: Peel Region Small Business AML Screener
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the graph-intelligence and LightGBM methodology of Bito, providing tangible enterprise utility that heavily resonates with business-minded hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized marketplace for Mississauga artisan goods featuring autonomous AI agents handling customer inquiries and automated USDC escrow settlement on Base.
ideas.title: Local Vendor Autonomous USDC Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning architecture of Dispatch by combining practical autonomous agent workflows with real-world crypto-payment escrow mechanics.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition platform that maps local Ontario produce availability to personalized weekly meal plans and health guidance for community wellness.
ideas.title: Ontario Farm-to-Table Nutrition Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact execution playbook of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by delivering immediate, highly polished consumer utility within a tight timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery analysis tool that tracks land-use changes and industrial environmental compliance violations across Peel Region manufacturing zones.
ideas.title: Industrial Zone Compliance Satellite Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the computer vision and geospatial monitoring success of GeoNex-ATLAS, offering judges a visually striking and technically complex infrastructure solution.
